description: Price an email verification waterfall: the list run through verifiers in sequence with unknowns passed down the chain, every order compared, cheapest cost per usable email first. Uses typical figures for three verifiers unless you pass your own prices and resolve rates (POST JSON for verifiers). Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

verifiers.description: Optional: up to 5 verifiers with pricePer1k (USD), resolvePct (share given a definite answer) and validOfResolvedPct (share of those that are valid).

name: plan_verification_waterfall

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.
